finding.claim: The POST /admin/users/<uid>/ban route calls do_ban(uid) even when require_admin(g.user) fails, because the 403 abort is swallowed by a broad except Exception. Any caller whose g.user has a falsy is_admin can ban arbitrary users.
finding.source: Request path segment <uid> (attacker-chosen), and a request whose g.user is populated with is_admin falsy (upstream population of g.user is not in this directory)

trace.note: ban route registered for POST /admin/users/<uid>/ban with no decorator or before_request admin guard in this file
non-admin user triggers abort(403), raising an HTTPException
except Exception swallows the HTTPException (werkzeug HTTPException subclasses Exception)
only a log.warning is emitted; execution continues

finding.guards_checked: require_admin raises via abort(403) but its exception is discarded by the try/except at admin.py:18, so the check does not gate the action (pattern of expertise case 01-perm-result-ignored). No decorator or before_request admin guard exists in admin.py for this route. The unban route (admin.py:24-28) calls require_admin unwrapped and is not affected. No expertise decoy (25, 27, 28) matches this shape. do_ban body is a stub in this directory, so downstream ownership/tenant checks could not be verified; g.user population and any upstream auth middleware are outside this directory.

verdict.guard_found: require_admin (admin.py:9-11) raises via abort(403), but its result is a bare call inside try (admin.py:16-19) whose `except Exception` swallows the HTTPException and only logs a warning, so the check does not gate do_ban(uid) at admin.py:20. No decorator or before_request admin guard exists in admin.py for the ban route (admin.py:14-15). The unban route (admin.py:24-28) calls require_admin unwrapped and is not affected.
verdict.reason: At admin.py:17-20 the abort(403) raised by require_admin (admin.py:11) is caught by the broad `except Exception` at admin.py:18, which only logs at line 19, so do_ban(uid) at line 20 runs for any authenticated caller whose g.user has a falsy is_admin. The trace is accurate, and the only caveat is that do_ban is a stub here, so the downstream effect and any upstream auth middleware outside this directory are not verified.
